items.name: Wildflowers
items.description: A crooked bunch picked from the edge of town.

items.name: Sweet Bun
items.description: Still warm. Nobody knows who baked it.

items.name: Tarnished Coin
items.description: Currency from somewhere that no longer exists.

items.name: Prayer Beads
items.description: Worn smooth by a lot of worrying.

items.name: Cheap Whiskey
items.description: It burns. That's the whole review.

items.name: Black Candle
items.description: It never seems to burn down.

items.name: Bone Dice
items.description: They always seem to land on the same number.

items.name: Rusty Knife
items.description: Nobody remembers whose it was. Everyone remembers what it did.

items.name: Fine Perfume
items.description: A little bottle that smells like money.

items.name: Wooden Toy
items.description: A little painted horse with a chipped ear.

items.name: Box of Chocolates
items.description: One is missing. You're not sure who took it.

items.name: Herbal Tea
items.description: Smells like a garden you've never been to.

items.name: Mystery Powder
items.description: Sold by a man who wouldn't give his name.
